title: Commercial Road Vehicles - Drawbar Couplings and Eyes for Rigid Drawbars - Strength Tests
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies the test conditions and strength requirements to be met by drawbar couplings and the corresponding drawbar eyes for rigid drawbars, which are provided for use with centre-axle trailers with a maximum towing mass C exceeding 3.5 tonnes.
clause_3_terminology: Drawbar Couplings and Eyes for Rigid Drawbars

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
